personalInfo.statement: I was born and raised in Charlotte and I love anything related to technology. My main interests are drones, cameras, radios, soldering, and 3D printing. I love to build things for practical use cases and create media that people can enjoy.
personalInfo.personalBackground: I am Italian and have a large Italian family scattered around the US.

personalInfo.academicBackground: Associates in Welding, working on my Bachelors in CS.
